title: Influencers
sub: Ads in your shop’s name and an influencer’s: their followers see their name, the orders come to you.
noBrand: First link the shop’s Facebook Page and Instagram account (Pilot AI › Accounts): the requests go from them.

list.title: Your influencers
list.emptySub: Add their Instagram: they say yes once in the app, then you launch ads in both your names.

stHelp.pending: They must accept in the Instagram app (Settings › Branded content).
stHelp.approved: You can launch ads in both your names.
stHelp.refused: They refused: talk to them, then ask again.
stHelp.revoked: No new ad in their name.
stHelp.page: Meta asks for their OK at the first ad.
stHelp.code: They gave an ad code for one post.

removeSub: No new ad in their name. The ads already launched stay in your numbers.

posts.title: Their posts that tag you
posts.sub: A ready post becomes an ad in 1 click: it keeps its words and video, with your “Shop now” button.
posts.empty: No post tags the shop yet.

steps.title: How it works
steps.s1: Add their Instagram: Pilotix sends them the request.
steps.s2: They say yes once, in the Instagram app.
steps.s3: Launch an ad in both your names: your photos, your page, their name.
steps.s4: Pilotix counts their orders and delivered orders.

igHelp: They get the request in the Instagram app and say yes once: then you launch all the ads you want in both your names.
pageHelp: Ask them for it (Page › About › Page transparency). Meta asks for their OK at the first ad.
codeLabel: Ad code or the post’s link
codePh: Code given by the influencer, or https://www.instagram.com/p/…
codeHelp: For one post only: the influencer copies their “ad code” in Instagram (… › Partnership permissions).
sent: Request sent: they must say yes in Instagram
